tasks.label: Avvia CodeSpace in locale
args: Write-Host 'Killing previous processes...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Get-Process CodeSpace,node,esbuild -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host 'Cleaning temp build artifacts...' -ForegroundColor Yellow; if (Test-Path 'src-tauri/target/debug/deps/.tmp*') { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force 'src-tauri/target/debug/deps/.tmp*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path 'src-tauri/target/debug/build') { Get-ChildItem 'src-tauri/target/debug/build' -Directory -Filter '.tmp*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Starting CodeSpace...' -ForegroundColor Green; npx tauri dev

tasks.label: Test: Live Server
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Simulated Live Server - http://127.0.0.1:9090' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[OK] Server started' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[OK] Watching for changes...' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[OK] Hot-reload enabled' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Press Ctrl+C to stop' -ForegroundColor Yellow; ping -t 127.0.0.1

tasks.label: Test: PHP Server
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  PHP Built-in Server - http://127.0.0.1:8089' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; $tmpDir = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'cs-php-test'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmpDir | Out-Null; '<?php echo "[php-server] CodeSpace test OK @ " . date("H:i:s"); ?>' | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $tmpDir 'index.php') -Encoding utf8; Write-Host '[OK] Document root:' $tmpDir -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[OK] PHP version:' (php -v | Select-Object -First 1) -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Press Ctrl+C to stop' -ForegroundColor Yellow; php -S 127.0.0.1:8089 -t $tmpDir

tasks.label: Test: NPM
args: $ver = npm --version; $node = node --version; Write-Host 'NPM:' $ver -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host 'Node:' $node -ForegroundColor Cyan; if (Test-Path 'package.json') { $pkg = Get-Content package.json | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Project:' $pkg.name -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host 'Dependencies:' $pkg.dependencies.PSObject.Properties.Name.Count -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[OK] All checks passed' -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host '[WARN] No package.json in current folder' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: Test: Echo (icon)
args: Write-Host '=== Echo Task Simulation ===' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; 1..5 | ForEach-Object { Write-Host ('[STEP ' + $_ + '/5] Processing item ' + $_ + '...') -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300 }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[OK] Echo task completed' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('Timestamp: ' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) -ForegroundColor Gray

tasks.label: Test: FTP Mount
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  FTP Mount Simulation' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[1/3] Checking rclone...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Host '[OK] rclone v1.68 found' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[2/3] Connecting to ftp.example.com...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; Write-Host '[OK] Connected (TLS 1.3)' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[3/3] Mounting to X:...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 600; Write-Host '[OK] Drive X: mounted successfully' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Mounted: ftp://example.com' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'Local:   X:' -ForegroundColor Yellow

tasks.label: Test: Upload
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Upload Simulation' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; $files = @('config.json','data.csv','report.pdf','logo.png','script.ps1'); $total = 0; foreach ($f in $files) { $size = Get-Random -Min 12 -Max 840; $total += $size; Write-Host ('[UPLOAD] ' + $f + '  (' + $size.ToString() + 'KB)') -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('[OK] ' + $files.Count.ToString() + ' files uploaded (' + $total.ToString() + ' KB)') -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[OK] Remote checksum verified' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: Test: Add User
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Create User Account' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; $email = Read-Host 'Email'; $name = Read-Host 'Display name (optional)'; if (-not $name) { $name = ($email -split '@')[0] }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Creating user...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Write-Host '[OK] User created' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ('  Email: ' + $email) -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ('  Name:  ' + $name) -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host '  Role:  admin' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('Password reset link sent to ' + $email) -ForegroundColor Cyan

tasks.label: Test: Sync
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Data Sync Simulation' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; $start = Get-Date; Write-Host '[1/6] Testing connectivity...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Write-Host '[OK] Connected to 5.135.1.236:3306 (MySQL 8.0)' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[2/6] Fetching remote schema...' -ForegroundColor Gray; $tables = @('prodotti','clienti','ordini','agenti','categorie','listini','magazzino','fatture','documenti','utenti'); foreach ($t in $tables) { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Host ('  -> ' + $t + ' [schema OK]') -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host '[3/6] Downloading delta changes...' -ForegroundColor Gray; $tables | ForEach-Object { $rows = Get-Random -Min 50 -Max 800; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700; Write-Host ('  -> ' + $_ + '_2026.csv  (' + $rows + ' rows)') -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host '[4/6] Validating checksums...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $tables | ForEach-Object { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 200; Write-Host ('  -> ' + $_ + ' [SHA256 OK]') -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host '[5/6] Importing into local DB...' -ForegroundColor Gray; $totalRows = 0; foreach ($t in $tables) { $rows = Get-Random -Min 80 -Max 600; $totalRows += $rows; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700; Write-Host ('  -> ' + $t + ' [' + $rows + ' rows imported]') -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host '[OK] Total: ' -NoNewline; Write-Host ($totalRows.ToString() + ' records') -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[6/6] Updating indexes...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Write-Host '[OK] Indexes rebuilt' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; $elapsed = [math]::Round(((Get-Date) - $start).TotalSeconds, 1); Write-Host ('Sync completed in ' + $elapsed.ToString() + 's') -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: Test: Push
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Git Push Simulation' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[1/3] Checking working tree...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 400; Write-Host '[OK] Working tree clean' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[2/3] Switching to master...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300; Write-Host '[OK] Switched to branch master' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host '[3/3] Pushing to origin/master...' -ForegroundColor Gray; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Host '[OK] Pushed 3 commits to origin/master' -ForegroundColor Green; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '  abc1234 Fix: update config' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '  def5678 Feat: add export module' -ForegroundColor Gray; Write-Host '  ghi9012 Chore: bump version' -ForegroundColor Gray

tasks.label: Test: PowerShell
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  PowerShell Automation Script' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'System Info:' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ('  Hostname : ' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); Write-Host ('  User     : ' + $env:USERNAME); Write-Host ('  OS       : ' + (Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Caption)); Write-Host ('  PS Ver   : ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()); Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'Running tasks...' -ForegroundColor Gray; 1..3 | ForEach-Object { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300; Write-Host ('  [' + $_ + '/3] Task completed') -ForegroundColor Gray }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[OK] All tasks finished successfully' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: Test: Default (no taskType)
args: Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  Generic Task (no taskType)' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '============================================' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'This task has no codeSpace.taskType set.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host 'It should render with the default icon.' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[OK] Default task executed successfully' -ForegroundColor Green
